lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, following a linear trajectory along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement where the blobs act as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the visible flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity values on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow in the ventral trough.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin extends into the lower center frame, exhibiting a high density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more structured pattern on the primary flank.
